I ported the C++ LRU cache simulator to Kotlin. All 5 example cases in `node check.mjs` pass. I also compared it against the original C++ binary on two 1,000,000-command inputs and a small edge-case input, and the output was byte-for-byte identical each time. The 1M-command runs took about 0.4s and 0.2s.
